text: {"headline": "Press 4 guard and interlock review: documented records, unverified reporter accounts, and open dates", "overview": "This brief summarizes the supplied calibrated claims about a Press 4 guard test, interlock failure, isolation, inspection sign-off, reconciliation ledger, and audit status. Document-based claims are presented as what the records state. Reporter statements are presented as allegations that the supplied claims could not verify. Several dates are unresolved, and some accounts conflict. The brief does not establish what happened, who was responsible, or whether any rule was broken.", "key_points": ["A chat export states that the interlock on Press 4 failed and that Iven Pell isolated Press 4 after the failure, on the following Monday; the calendar date of that Monday is unresolved. [C001, C002]", "A reporter-attributed account states that the guard failed to stop the press during the reporter's night shift and that the reporter isolated the press and told the day lead. These statements were not verified against documents. [C032, C033]", "The reporter-attributed account and the packet's isolation claim differ on who isolated Press 4, and the supplied claims do not resolve this. [C002, C033]", "A redacted chat participant stated they had the earlier copy and that totals did not match yet. Iven Pell asked them to keep the original and edit history, and the participant replied they would send it after shift; the verifier found the object of 'keep' is only implied. [C003, C004, C005]", "An email with subject 'Press 4 guard test and inspection packet' is recorded as sent on 4 March 2026 from a redacted sender to PERSON_1 PERSON_1. A reply on that subject from Iven Pell is recorded as sent on 6 March 2026. [C008, C042, C015]", "The packet records that PERSON_1 PERSON_1 signed the Press 4 safety inspection as complete on 4 March 2026. The supplied claims do not show any later verification of that sign-off. [C010]", "The checklist is recorded as reporting a 0.18-second stop on all four cycles, which appears in several documents. The reporter states they saved the checklist because the four identical readings looked wrong to them, and that they cannot say who physically entered the readings. [C011, C039, C034, C035, C036]", "The issue register is recorded as placing the handheld meter in calibration stores on the morning in question. [C012, C040]", "A 2 March log is recorded as stating that PERSON_1 PERSON_1 restarted Press 4 after Iven Pell isolated it; the verifier notes this entry is not described as uncorroborated in the supplied passages. The reporter states the restart entry was already in the shared file when they opened it and that its date might be a copied template. These accounts conflict. [C031, C037, C038]", "An email records that PERSON_1 PERSON_1 instructed maintenance to copy February's guard-test readings into the March sheet. This is an allegation; the verifier found that the attribution to Iven Pell's email and the 'uncorroborated' framing are not in the cited passage. [C016]", "The packet states that the production schedule shows a customer rush order but does not authorize skipping the test, and that the authorization and settlement fields are separate and should not be read as completion. [C041, C014, C018]", "The reconciliation ledger lists three items dated 2026-04-10: L001 Replacement interlock at 1850.00 USD, L002 External functional test at 640.00 USD, and L003 Calibration hire at 210.00 USD, with a packet total of 2700.00 USD marked 'control'. The three listed amounts sum to that total. The ledger does not show what the entries authorize or prove. [C020, C021, C022, C023]", "A document states that in early April PERSON_1 approved a replacement interlock for Press 4; the date is given only as 'early April'. [C019]", "The audit record is incomplete: the calendar extract does not show the audit date, the receipt states the audit date remains unconfirmed, and no signed audit report was available for the packet. The receipt also states it is not a certification of the underlying allegations. [C024, C025, C029, C030]", "The receipt records that after the audit, Iven Pell photographed the unsealed test terminal, and that the signed audit report and an independent copy of the source register are still requested. [C027, C028]", "A packet passage refers to a disputed change and asks for confirmation of who authorized it; the supplied claims do not identify the authorizer, though this observation is partly an inference from the passage. [C026]", "The packet states that no conclusions should be reached until the source records have been checked. [C007]"], "risk_notes": ["Many reporter statements (C032 to C038) have no verified document support and conflict in part with document-based claims about isolation, restart, and the shared log. They should be treated as unverified allegations.", "The 2 March restart log (C031) and the reporter's account that the restart entry was already present and may be a copied template (C037, C038) conflict. Neither account is established by the supplied claims.", "Isolation accounts differ: the chat export attributes isolation to Iven Pell (C002), while the reporter states they isolated the press (C033). Both are recorded as stated, not reconciled.", "Several dates are unresolved or broad, including 'the following Monday' (C001, C002), 'early April' (C019), and 'that morning' (C012, C040). Sequencing between events cannot be firmly established from the supplied claims.", "Some claims are single-source or only partly supported by the verifier (C005, C016, C017, C026, C031). The partial verdicts concern wording, attribution, or implied content, so these should not be read as confirmed.", "Redacted and placeholder identities (for example [REDACTED] and PERSON_1 PERSON_1) mean the supplied claims do not show who performed several actions. This brief does not infer those identities.", "Ledger entries and the sign-off record document what was recorded. They do not by themselves show whether the work was performed, authorized, or correct."], "limitations": ["The brief covers only the supplied calibrated claims. Absence of a claim here is not evidence that an event did not occur.", "Independent proof is limited. Most support is from a single document source. The 0.18-second stop has multiple sources, but it describes what the checklist reports, not whether the reading is accurate.", "No signed audit report, independent copy of the source register, or confirmed audit date is in the supplied claims, so the audit's status and findings cannot be assessed.", "Reporter allegations are unverified in the supplied claims, and none has document-based support recorded in the claim set.", "The supplied claims do not establish the cause of the interlock failure, whether the test was skipped, whether readings were copied or altered, who authorized the disputed change, or whether any policy was violated.", "Several claims have low sample agreement or partial verification, and the claim set is not a complete account of the underlying records."]}
